title: feat(i18n): the action param dialog's preflight panel reads its row labels from the bundle
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb2Fj9aZwUET7wDczt5jxUYa)_

Fixes #31937

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:控制台的动作参数对话框里,预检(preflight)面板每一行的标签现在会读翻译包里的 `preflight.fields.PATH`,中文、日文用户看到的是译文,不再是作者写的英文。
- **为什么改**:#31885 已在规范与 REST 侧加了这个翻译键,#31808 加了对话框,但控制台从没读过这个键,翻译写了也不生效。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低。只覆盖已声明的行,翻译包里多出的路径不加行,没有译文的行原样显示;没有 preflight 的动作完全不经过新代码。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts`(新成员 `actionPreflight` 与抽出的两个共用助手),`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`,`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/src/__tests__/useObjectLabel-actionPreflight-31937.test.tsx`,预期 5 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `useObjectLabel()` gains `actionPreflight(objectName, actionName, preflight)`, the client mirror of `actionResultDialog` for an action's declared `preflight` read and of the spec's `resolveActionPreflight`. It reads `objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION.preflight.fields` (with no key object, `globalActions.ACTION.preflight.fields`) whole, keyed by the literal row path, and overlays a non-empty string onto the matching DECLARED row only. A bundle path no row declares adds nothing; a row with no bundle string keeps its authored label, an inline per-locale map included. No spec, no action name or no declared rows returns the spec itself.
- The fetch-the-fields-node and overlay-the-rows steps are now two local helpers (`readActionFieldsNode`, `overlayActionFieldLabels`) that `actionResultDialog` and `actionPreflight` share; `actionResultDialog`'s behaviour is unchanged (its suite is green).
- Both console param-collection handlers (`useConsoleActionRuntime` and `RecordDetailView`) pass `action.preflight` through `actionPreflight` before handing it to `resolveParamDialogCompanion`, on the same key object the rest of the dialog's copy reads. They call it only when the action declares `preflight`, so the no-preflight branch is unchanged.
- `packages/spec/liveness/action.json`: the `preflight` note's open-gap sentence now says the console reads the key (`check:liveness` green).
- Changeset: patch on `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell`.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/useObjectLabel-actionPreflight-31937.test.tsx` (real i18next, zh session): the zh bundle label lands on its row with the dotted path as one key; an undeclared bundle path adds no row; CONTROL, a row with no bundle string, plain or an inline locale map, is the authored object itself; `globalActions` is read for an action with no key object and not for a bound one; the identity returns.
- The two `banCompanion-30205` suites gain `actionPreflight` in their `useObjectLabel` double and one top-level describe each: the localized rows reach the companion's judged block, asked on the action's own object, and an action with no preflight asks nothing.
- `useObjectLabel-identity-5564.test.tsx`: the member census moves 30 to 31 with a sentence naming the new member (both paths still carry the same member set).
- Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed tree: replacing the `readActionFieldsNode(objectName, actionName, 'preflight')` argument with `undefined` turns the zh-row and global-action cases red (2 failed, 3 passed); restore verified by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## Acceptance notes

- `ui/e2e/record-flow-phone-targets.spec.ts` reads `RecordDetailView.tsx` source for its Tailwind classes; this diff adds no class, and the spec runs in CI's Playwright jobs.
- The call-site guard (call only when `preflight` is set) was agreed with the seat so the other `useConsoleActionRuntime` suites, whose `useObjectLabel` doubles carry no `actionPreflight`, stay untouched.
